title: Primary Science — Plant Water Loss
subject: science
disclaimer: Conceptual illustrative influence of light, moving air and humidity on transpiration, not a measured rate. Real stomata respond to other factors.

beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict whether humid air speeds up or slows down water loss from leaves.

beats.label: Observe
beats.narration: Increase humidity and observe the conceptual transpiration activity decrease.

beats.label: Explain
beats.narration: Water exits mainly as invisible vapour through stomata; the surrounding air affects diffusion.

check.question: On a humid day, which trend is generally expected if other conditions stay comparable?
check.explanation: A smaller difference in water vapour concentration generally reduces diffusion from leaves.
